_comment: HARNESS-12. Dependency currency was manual, and manual is why main went red for four days in
July (docs/build-log.md, REPO HEALTH 22 Jul) and why the Q4 gate broke again on 2026-08-04 —
both times from advisories published while nothing was watching, not from anything a commit did.
NO AUTOMERGE, anywhere, deliberately. Renovate opens the PR and CI judges it; a human merges.
HG-0001 (docs/governance/) makes non-self-merge a governance control, and a bot merging its own
PR is exactly the hole that control exists to close — convenience is not worth re-opening it.
pnpm.overrides in package.json are NOT managed here: they are deliberate security FLOORS for
advisories a parent pins below the patch, each carrying a justification in overridesNote. Renovate
would happily churn them; they should be REMOVED by hand once the parent ships a patched range.

packageRules.description: Non-major dev dependencies travel together — one PR, one CI run, one review.
Runtime dependencies ship to the demo and to an adopting bank — never grouped, so each is reviewable on its own diff.
Majors are a story, not a bump: they get their own PR and a human decision (vitest 3->4, tailwind 3->4, jsdom, next).
The toolchain that runs the gates — pinned deliberately; surface changes but never sneak them in.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly window and the major-approval gate — an advisory is not a scheduled chore. Still human-merged.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
